title: UNIT 6: CLIMATE CHANGE
notes: ✓ Climate change → long-term, systematic change in Earth’s climate, especially changes in temperature, precipitation and wind, largely influenced by human activities.

title: 6.1 CLIMATE CHANGE: CAUSES
notes:
✓ Climate change occurs when natural and human activities alter Earth’s energy balance.

✓ Major human causes → burning fossil fuels • deforestation • livestock farming.
✓ Result → ↑ greenhouse gases → ↑ greenhouse effect → global warming.

title: GLOBAL WARMING vs CLIMATE CHANGE
notes:
✓ Global warming → increase in Earth’s average temperature.

✓ Climate change → broader long-term changes including warming, rainfall changes, melting glaciers, sea-level rise and extreme weather.

title: 6.1.1 GREENHOUSE GASES
notes:
✓ Greenhouse gases (GHGs) → gases that absorb and re-radiate heat, trapping heat in the atmosphere.

✓ Main gases & sources:

◆ CO₂ → fossil-fuel combustion, deforestation.
◆ CH₄ → biomass combustion, agricultural wastes.
◆ N₂O → fertilizer use.
◆ SO₂ → coal, oil and diesel combustion.
◆ Fluorinated gases → refrigeration.

title: GREENHOUSE EFFECT
notes:
✓ Solar energy enters Earth → Earth absorbs energy → heat is radiated back → greenhouse gases trap part of the heat → atmosphere warms.

✓ Natural greenhouse effect → makes Earth habitable.

✓ Increased GHG concentration → additional heat trapped → ↑ average global temperature.

title: CARBON DIOXIDE & CARBON CYCLE
notes:
✓ CO₂ is exchanged among atmosphere, plants, animals and oceans through photosynthesis, respiration, decomposition and gas exchange.

✓ Main human source → fossil-fuel combustion.
✓ Deforestation → releases stored carbon.
✓ Human emissions are faster than natural removal processes → CO₂ accumulates in the atmosphere.

title: 6.1.2 EFFECTS OF CLIMATE CHANGE
notes:
✓ Direct effects → ↑ maximum temperatures • ↑ sea levels • ↑ ocean temperatures • heavier precipitation • shrinking glaciers • thawing permafrost.

✓ Indirect effects → hunger and water crises • health risks • economic problems • spread of pests/pathogens • biodiversity loss • ocean acidification.

title: EFFECTS ON BIODIVERSITY
notes:
✓ Climate change alters habitats and environmental conditions.

✓ Species may → adapt • migrate • decline • become extinct.
✓ Climate change + land-use change + invasive species → can accelerate biodiversity loss.
✓ Changes in rainfall and temperature can damage plants, animals and their habitats.

title: 6.2 CLIMATE CHANGE & NATURAL DISASTERS
notes:
✓ Increasing global temperatures can increase the likelihood or intensity of some climate hazards.

✓ Heavy rainfall → floods.
✓ Higher temperatures → drought risk.
✓ More atmospheric water vapour → stronger storms.
✓ Melting ice + thermal expansion → rising sea levels.

title: MELTING ICE & RISING SEA LEVELS
notes:
✓ Global warming → polar ice sheets and glaciers melt.

✓ At the same time → warmer water expands.

✓ Combined effect → ↑ sea level → flooding and erosion of coastal and low-lying areas.

title: EXTREME WEATHER & HUMAN HEALTH
notes:
✓ Extreme weather and changing rainfall can cause → floods • reduced water quality • reduced water availability • crop failure.

✓ Health impacts → heat-related deaths • changes in spread of water-borne diseases • changes in disease-vector distribution.

title: 6.3 SAFETY DURING NATURAL DISASTERS
notes:
✓ Disaster risk management → identifying hazards + preparing and applying measures to reduce damage.

✓ Preparation cannot always prevent disasters, but it can reduce loss of life and property.

title: EARTHQUAKE SAFETY
notes:
✓ Indoors → take cover under sturdy furniture • stay away from windows/glass • remain inside until shaking stops • do not use elevators.

✓ Outdoors → move away from buildings, streetlights and utility wires • stay in open ground.

title: TSUNAMI SAFETY
notes:
✓ Tsunami → series of large ocean waves caused by earthquakes, underwater landslides or volcanic eruptions.

✓ Safety → follow official warnings • move immediately to higher ground/inland • retreat if sea water suddenly recedes • avoid flooded/damaged areas and water debris.

title: CYCLONE SAFETY
notes:
✓ Cyclone → tropical storm associated with a low-pressure area and strong winds.

✓ Be alert to weather changes.
✓ Follow radio/TV warnings.
✓ Watch for warning signs.
✓ Seek shelter immediately when danger is indicated.

title: FLOOD SAFETY
notes:
✓ Flood → water flows over land that is normally dry.

✓ Safety → never walk, swim or drive through floodwater • avoid fast-moving water and bridges • follow evacuation alerts • move to higher ground.

title: CLIMATE CHANGE MITIGATION
notes:
✓ Climate change mitigation → actions that reduce greenhouse-gas emissions or remove CO₂ from the atmosphere.

✓ 3 main approaches:

1 Decarbonization → renewable energy • fuel switching • efficiency • nuclear power • carbon capture.

2 Carbon sequestration → afforestation • reforestation • soil carbon storage • wetland restoration.

3 Radiation management → altering Earth’s radiation balance.

title: CARBON SEQUESTRATION
notes:
✓ Carbon sequestration → capture and storage of CO₂ from the atmosphere.

✓ Examples → forests • soils • wetlands • oceans.
✓ Afforestation and reforestation increase biological storage of carbon.

title: 6.4 INTERNATIONAL CONVENTIONS
notes:
✓ Climate change is a long-term global problem requiring international cooperation and continuing policies.

✓ Important agreements → UNFCCC • Kyoto Protocol • Paris Climate Agreement.

title: 6.4.1 UNFCCC
notes:
✓ United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) → international environmental treaty agreed in 1992.

✓ Main objective → prevent dangerous human interference with the climate system, including stabilizing greenhouse-gas concentrations.

title: 6.4.2 KYOTO PROTOCOL
notes:
✓ Kyoto Protocol → adopted on 11 December 1997; operationalized the UNFCCC.

✓ Main focus → legally committed industrialized countries and economies in transition to limit/reduce greenhouse-gas emissions according to agreed targets.

✓ Original target → 5% reduction below 1990 levels during 2008–2012.

title: UNIT 6 QUICK REVISION
notes:
✓ Climate change = long-term change in climate

✓ Main human causes = fossil fuels + deforestation + livestock farming

✓ GHGs = CO₂ + CH₄ + N₂O + SO₂ + fluorinated gases

✓ ↑ GHGs → ↑ trapped heat → global warming

✓ Biodiversity → habitat change + species loss

✓ Agriculture → reduced productivity and food insecurity

✓ Forests → pests + invasive species + wildfire + storms

✓ Melting ice + thermal expansion → ↑ sea level

✓ Disaster preparation → reduces damage and loss of life

✓ Mitigation → emission reduction + carbon sequestration + radiation management
